note: golden_hash filled by golden-parity.test.mjs --update. Vector 1: 10-of-10 full sample, complete transcript. Vector 2: 20000-of-20000 full sample, exactly 20000 draws, transcript truncated at 50 entries (the shape the v1 sampler draw cap could not produce). Vectors 3-6: structured refusals (zero sample size, sha256: prefix, 63-hex randomness, over-ceiling population).

vectors.name: drand_quicknet_n10_full_sample
vectors.description: drand quicknet pulse round 4321000, 10-item manifest, 10-of-10 full sample: unbiased threshold reduction over a partial Fisher-Yates, exactly 10 accepted draws, complete transcript, verdict DERIVED. A full sample of this shape is where the v1 sampler draw cap first binds at larger populations.

vectors.name: nistir_8213_n20000_full_sample
vectors.description: NISTIR-8213 pulse, 20000-item manifest, 20000-of-20000 full sample: succeeds in exactly 20000 draws. The v1 sampler would have needed about 216000 coupon-collector draws and failed against its 200000 draw cap; v2 has no cap. Transcript capped at 50 entries with transcript_truncated true.

vectors.name: sample_size_zero_refusal
vectors.description: sample_size 0 is a structured refusal: verdict INDETERMINATE, MALFORMED_INPUT, no derivation attempted.

reasons: sample_size must be a positive integer (0 or missing is a refusal)

vectors.name: manifest_hash_prefix_bad_hex_refusal
vectors.description: item_manifest_hash carrying a sha256: prefix fails the exact 64-lowercase-hex validation: structured refusal naming the rule.

reasons: item_manifest_hash must be exactly 64 lowercase hex characters (0-9, a-f), without a sha256: prefix

vectors.name: randomness_63_hex_refusal
vectors.description: beacon_randomness of 63 hex characters (the length the v1 sampler accepted unvalidated) fails the exact 64-lowercase-hex validation.

reasons: beacon_randomness must be exactly 64 lowercase hex characters (0-9, a-f)

vectors.name: item_count_over_ceiling_refusal
vectors.description: item_count above the 1000000 ceiling is refused before the 4 MB index array is allocated: documents the guest-memory bound.

reasons: item_count must be an integer between 1 and 1000000
